Business Model & Industry Issues  
 Sabina places importance on supply chain management of all processes in the business chain, ranging from production, warehous e, 
transportation to distribution management. It al so takes into account the use of resources in production and creates value for products and 
services through various innovations.  
 Sabina operates its business in tandem with ESG approach to manage negative environmental impact, in terms of energy consumpti on, pollution 
or waste management. It reduces the impact of climate change and strives for sustainable development in accordance with the S ustainable 
Development Goals.  
 Being in a labour -intensive industry, the company must have safety measures and promote  good quality of life while adopting advanced 
production technology and innovation, including state -of-the-art machinery in order to produce quality products to cater to consumers ’ 
requirements.  
 
   
Material E issues  
 In 2020, all Sabina plants reduced th eir electricity consumption by 
22%, above the target of 15% by shifting from air conditioning to  
evapolative cooling system and electronic equipment modifications 
such as industrial sewing machines, light bulbs, air conditioners and 
air pumps.  
 In 2020, th e organization's water usage was reduced by 14% from 
2019, better than the target of 10%, and regulated wastewater 
management to meet statutory standards and does not have a 
negative impact on the community.  
 Control air pollution from the foaming moulding process, dust not 
exceeding 400 ml. per cubic metre and chemicals (toluene) not 
exceeding 200 ppm, as well as reducing fuel consumption. 
Greenhouse gas emission from transport fell to 20.16% vs the target 
of 10% and the reduction of greenhouse gas emission  from travelling 
to meetings fell to 77.7%  vs the target of 20%, resulting in a 24.11%  
reduction in overall greenhouse gas emission in 2020. 
 Using the 3R (Reuse, Reduce, Recycle) principle. General waste, 
which is landfill, is reduced by 43% in 2020, vs th e target of 30%, 
and the amount of waste generated from the production process is 
reduced by 40% vs the target of 30%. 
 In 2020, Sabina was certified GREEN INDUSTRY Level 2 (Green 
Operations, implementing activities to reduce environmental 
impacts) for all 5 factories and it ’s preparing to upgrade to Green 
Industry Level 3 (Effective Environmental Management, which has 
been monitored and evaluated for continuous improvement).  
 Implement a zero -waste project by recycling raw materials left 
over from production  and transforming them into products.

1. Recap : Strong 3Q23 earnings in line  
SABINA’s 3Q23 earnings reached  a new record of THB119m (+19% YoY and 
+3% QoQ), in line with our and market expectations.  
 
 Total sales grew 10% YoY due to strong non -store retailing (NSR) sales 
growth of 57% YoY , which mo re than offset the decrease in off -line 
sales by 2% YoY from the high base. The new “Braless” products have 
been well -received by customers  while the promotion campaign also 
boosted NSR sales.  
 SABINA also recognized sales from Moda Philippines. However, O EM 
income declined 30% YoY due to  delayed order s by European 
customers.  
 Gross margin rose by  278bps YoY to 50.8% as the price s of new products 
are higher and there was less contribution from OEM income.  
 SG&A rose 12% YoY, with SG&A -to-sales rising to 33.3 %, from 32.7% in 
3Q22, due to more advertising and marketing expenses for the new 
products.  
 
9M23 earnings achieved  75% of our FY23  forecast . We maintain our forecasts  
and expect 4Q23 earnings to remain solid due to seasonal factor s and more 
online campai gns.
